title: English Practice Quiz 0976
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: At a hotel, the person who welcomes arriving guests is usually at the ___.
questions.explanation: Guests normally check in at the reception desk.

questions.question: A 'check-in time' is when a guest may ___.
questions.explanation: Check-in is the process of registering on arrival.

questions.question: A 'single room' is generally intended for ___.
questions.explanation: A single room is designed for one occupant.

questions.question: If your flight is cancelled, you should contact ___.
options: the airline or its authorised service desk
questions.explanation: The airline can provide official rebooking or refund information.

questions.question: A 'boarding pass' is used to ___.
questions.explanation: A boarding pass confirms permission to board a flight.

questions.question: Which phrase asks whether breakfast is included?
options: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
questions.explanation: This asks whether breakfast is part of the accommodation price.

questions.question: A 'round-trip ticket' usually covers ___.
options: the journey to a place and back
questions.explanation: A round trip includes outbound and return travel.

questions.question: If you lose your hotel key card, you should ___.
questions.explanation: Reception can deactivate the lost card and issue a replacement.

questions.question: A 'layover' is a period spent ___.
questions.explanation: A layover is a stop between parts of a journey.

questions.question: A travel itinerary provides ___.
questions.explanation: An itinerary outlines the arrangements for a trip.
